data.one_liner: Flutter image compression and resizing for Mobile, Desktop, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API for compressing and resizing JPG, PNG, and WEBP images across mobile, desktop, and web platforms. It combines native mobile compression with cross-platform desktop and web packages under the hood.
use_when: You need to compress or resize images before uploading them on mobile, desktop, or web.
You want a single cross-platform API that handles different underlying compressors per platform.
avoid_when: You only need basic image rendering or caching.
You need complex image editing operations beyond compression and resizing.
strengths: Cross-platform support including mobile, desktop, and web.
Supports JPG, PNG, and WEBP formats.
weaknesses: Relies on different underlying packages per platform (native vs cross-platform).

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a pure Dart solution for image processing without relying on platform-specific native plugins.
